caveats: Clusters are named from titles, resolution values and resolve dates, not from a full resolution-criteria read of each question.

Cluster ids are assigned over the UNION cohort, but collapse is computed within the cohort being measured, so a cluster split across eras (brent_spot_aug2026, anthropic_release_and_access_2026, mideast_shipping_disruption_2026, metaculus_cup_summer_2026_standings, aug2026_rates_and_risk) collapses less inside a single-era arm.
The degraded_run, partial_degraded and known_bug records are cluster members and are excluded from the strict cohorts, so the strict effective n already reflects that.

Weak clusters are a judgment call. us_2026_cycle_top_donors is the weakest of them: one database read on one date, but the two parties' top donors are separate people with separate motives, and the pair resolved in opposite directions.

This file labels 113 of the dataset's 905 records. The summer post_flip arm as a whole (184 records) is NOT clustered, so any test comparing a collapsed triple arm against an uncollapsed post_flip arm is still generous to the triple arm.
round_notes.siblings_note: Quote the strong-only number as primary and the strong-and-weak number as the conservative bound. Unlike the prior round, strong clusters DO reach into this new wave, so the new wave's effective n is genuinely below its record count.

cyclosporiasis_2026_season.basis: Carried and now five members: five readings of the 2026 cyclosporiasis season. US case count (44842, +26.0 spot), 44 or more states reporting (44873, +36.1, gemini-only degraded), any deaths (44874, -105.3, gemini-only degraded), NEW Michigan hospitalizations under 300 (44856, +34.0, 2-of-3 partial degraded) and NEW global hospitalizations (44951, +100.6, the round's biggest single win). One outbreak trajectory drives all five, so the round's largest August miss and its largest win are the same draw seen twice.

fl_primary_2026_08_18.basis: Carried from 2026-08-24. The 2026 Florida primary on 2026-08-18: FL-06 Republican ballot (45189), the Democratic Chief Financial Officer binary (45084) and the DeSantis endorsement binary (44870, degraded_run). 44381, the statewide Republican gubernatorial ballot, is post_flip and outside the cohort: named, not counted.

us_natl_polling_aug14.basis: Carried from 2026-08-24. One US national-polling snapshot dated 2026-08-14/15: Trump approval (44841, partial_degraded), the Democratic generic-ballot lead (44855) and the share opposing the Iran War (44858). One national mood moves all three together. 44807 (does the generic-ballot lead fail to reach 7.0, read on a different date) is deliberately not a member; see rejected_links.

metaculus_cup_summer_2026_standings.basis: NEW. Three reads of ONE final leaderboard, the Summer 2026 Metaculus Cup: will a bot beat all humans (44209, -8.9 spot), will a bot finish top five (44956, +28.3) and will the Community beat Dylan Matthews (43918, +20.7). The first two are near-mechanically nested, since beating every human implies a top-five finish. 45173 (a human at number one on the MarketPulse leaderboard) is a different tournament and stays a singleton.

uk_labour_leadership_2026.basis: NEW. One UK Labour leadership-challenge outcome through August 2026: will Keir Starmer cease to be Prime Minister before September (43664, +62.9 spot) and will Wes Streeting formally submit nominations to trigger a contest (43666, +13.6). A successful challenge resolves both, so they are one draw. 44911, the Labour 7-poll moving average on 08-31 (+81.5, the party's standing rather than its leadership), is a rejected link.

ebola_drc_2026.basis: NEW. One 2026 Democratic Republic of the Congo Ebola outbreak, read on two instruments: the count of laboratory-confirmed Bundibugyo cases the World Health Organization reports (43667, -36.0 spot, the wave's fourth-worst miss) and whether the WHO reports spread to a seventh Congolese province (45365, +24.3). Outbreak size and geographic spread are the same epidemic curve, so the miss and the win are not independent.

us_aug2026_jobs_report.basis: NEW. One release, the US Bureau of Labor Statistics Employment Situation for August 2026 (published 2026-09-04): nonfarm jobs added (45401, +62.1 spot) and the seasonally adjusted U-3 unemployment rate (44943, +6.3). One survey pair sets both numbers. 45199 (people affected by tech layoffs per the TrueUp tracker) reads a different instrument and is rejected.

atlantic_hurricane_season_2026.basis: NEW. One Atlantic hurricane season through August 2026: whether a hurricane made landfall in the continental United States before September (43744, -11.5 spot) and how many major hurricanes of Category 3 or higher occurred (44055, +47.3). A quiet season suppresses both counts, so the pair is one draw of seasonal activity.

brent_spot_aug2026.basis: NEW, split out of the carried aug2026_asset_prices cluster. Two thresholds on ONE Brent crude price path in the same window: Brent futures closing below 100 dollars on 08-17 (45080, +10.4 spot) and Brent spot reaching 130 dollars before September (43665, +4.3). One price series resolves both. Kept strong even though the members straddle the post_flip / triple boundary, which means it collapses less inside a single-era arm.

nuri_rocket_schedule_2026.basis: NEW. One South Korean launch-schedule decision: whether a specific date for the fifth Nuri launch was announced (45244, -9.1 spot) and whether the officially targeted launch month became something other than October 2026 (45245, +18.9). One announcement resolves both.

aug2026_rates_and_risk.basis: Carried from 2026-08-24 and re-based after the energy questions were split out. One month of August 2026 rates and risk appetite across instruments: the Treasury futures NOB spread on 08-14 (44868) and again on 08-31 (45086, NEW), the 30-year Treasury yield holding at or above 5 percent all month (45167, NEW), the highest intraday VIX (45172, NEW, -32.4 spot, the wave's sixth-worst miss), the S&P 500 change over the last week of August (45362) and the Ethereum August high (44882). Stays WEAK: different asset classes, and the two NOB reads are the same instrument on different dates, which the prior rounds treat as separate draws. Out-of-cohort former members, named only: 44008 (SpaceX share price), 43748 (30-year mortgage rate), 44773 (Brent 08-28) and 44797 (USD/SZL).

aug2026_retail_fuel.basis: NEW. Two retail fuel prices in the same month: the average lower-Atlantic US diesel price on 08-31 (45193, +4.3 spot) and whether US gasoline prices set a new all-time high (44957, +18.4). Both ride the crude path that brent_spot_aug2026 prices, but through their own refining and retail margins, so WEAK rather than folded into the Brent pair.

aug2026_heat_records.basis: NEW. One Northern Hemisphere August 2026 heat regime on three scales: Death Valley reaching 125 degrees Fahrenheit (44954, +76.7 spot), August being the warmest on record per Copernicus (45162, +21.8) and which US state was hottest on 08-31 (45191, -6.5). A hot month lifts all three, but a local daily extreme and a global monthly anomaly are far apart, so WEAK. 45200 (a Swiss cantonal open-fire ban) is a policy act and is rejected.

frontier_lab_ipo_2026.basis: NEW. One artificial-intelligence financing regime: whether OpenAI filed an S-1 initial registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission before September (43893, +25.0 spot) and whether Anthropic did (44620, +41.9). Two independent boards, one market window, so WEAK.

anthropic_release_and_access_2026.basis: Renamed from anthropic_frontier_release_cycle and re-based. One Anthropic release and deployment cadence: whether an Anthropic model held number one on the Chatbot Text Arena leaderboard at the end of August (44871, +17.5 spot, degraded_run) and the access status of Claude Fable and Mythos on 09-01 (44207, NEW, +20.0). 43638 (Claude Mythos released before September), which anchored the prior round's version, is post_flip and no longer new, so it is outside this cohort and named only.

mideast_shipping_disruption_2026.basis: Renamed from hormuz_closure_2026 and re-based. One Middle East maritime-disruption regime read on two straits: the Strait of Hormuz Monitor showing Closed on 08-31 (44804, +14.0 spot) and Bab el-Mandeb transit calls being cut by half or more on 08-31 (44955, NEW, +0.8). Same conflict, different chokepoints and different operators' routing decisions, so WEAK. 44049 (Hormuz traffic returning to normal in June), the prior version's other member, is post_flip and out of cohort.

starlink_country_rollout_2026.basis: NEW. One company's rollout cadence read on two markets: whether Starlink's website showed South Africa as available before September (43758, +28.1 spot) and whether it showed India (43759, +26.8). One corporate launch calendar and one website, but two independent national regulators, so WEAK. Same shape as the carried Anthropic release cluster.

ocha_appeal_funding_sep2026.basis: NEW. Two humanitarian appeals read off ONE instrument on one date, the UN Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs Financial Tracking Service: the percentage of the 2026 Lebanon Flash Appeal funded (45195, +16.1 spot) and of the 2026 Escalation of Hostilities in the Occupied Palestinian Territory appeal (45196, +58.7). One donor environment and one tracker, two separate appeals, so WEAK.

us_2026_cycle_top_donors.basis: NEW. One dated campaign-finance database read on 09-01, two parties: the largest Republican donor of the 2026 cycle (45187, -46.9 spot, the wave's fifth-worst miss) and the largest Democratic donor (45188, +16.6). Same instrument and date, but which individual tops each list is a separate fact, so WEAK.

russia_ukraine_diplomacy_aug2026.basis: NEW. One Russia-Ukraine diplomatic track through August 2026: a Zelenskyy-Putin in-person meeting before September (43939, +7.0 spot), a Trump-Putin phone call during August (44703, +12.8) and Ukraine announcing a presidential election before September (44053, +8.8), which in practice requires a settlement. One negotiation trajectory, three different events, so WEAK.

aug2026_asset_prices.note: SPLIT this round rather than retired for lack of members: the Brent pair became the strong brent_spot_aug2026 cluster, retail fuel became aug2026_retail_fuel, and the remainder is aug2026_rates_and_risk. 44008 and 43748 left the cohort.

poll_lead_or_average_on_date.basis: 'What will the lead or the polling average read on <date>', resolved off an aggregator.

published_series_level.basis: 'What will <official published series> read on <date>': the pipeline path is fetch the series and extrapolate (time-series anchor, financial data, resolution-source fetcher).

live_tracker_or_leaderboard_snapshot.basis: 'Who or what tops <leaderboard>' and 'what does <live tracker> show on <date>': resolves off a live web page.

asset_or_commodity_price_level.basis: A market level, change or threshold on a date.

election_result_ballot.basis: Who wins, or what the vote share or seat count is, in a scheduled election or referendum.

event_or_announcement_by_date.basis: 'Will <discrete event, official announcement, visit or launch> happen before <date>'.

count_in_period.basis: 'How many <events> in <period>', counted off a live list.

rejected_links.reason: The UK Labour 7-poll moving average on 08-31 (44911, +81.5 spot) reads the party's standing, while the leadership pair reads whether Starmer survived. A challenge would move the polls, but the polls did not resolve the challenge, and folding a weak member into a strong cluster would misstate the cluster's strength. Template family only.

Both read the Democratic generic-ballot lead, on different dates (08-31 versus 08-14). 44855 sits in the same-day strong cluster us_natl_polling_aug14, and a different date is a different draw of the instrument. Carried rejection.

Tech-layoff headcount from the TrueUp tracker (45199, +81.8 spot) is a private web tracker of announcements, not the Bureau of Labor Statistics survey pair that resolves the jobs-report cluster. Same subject, different instrument and different universe.

Both are Lebanon in the same window, but the Lebanese Armed Forces deploying to two pilot zones (44619, -48.9 spot, the wave's third-worst miss) is a security milestone and the Flash Appeal funding percentage is a donor-behaviour read. No shared resolving driver.

The Swiss Canton of Valais open-fire ban (45200, +22.2 spot) is a cantonal legal act with its own thresholds and review dates. European fire danger correlates with the August heat regime, but a policy decision is not a temperature reading.

Three Ocearch shark-tracker reads (a Contender ping by 08-14, sharks tracked on 08-31, Percy's location on 09-01). Different quantities off one live tracker are a METHOD correlation, template family live_tracker_or_leaderboard_snapshot, not one world state. Carried rejection; 44877 is still unresolved.

A funding round for Lovable, DeepSeek or Perplexity (45094, -47.9 spot, the wave's fourth-worst miss) is private late-stage financing for second-tier labs; the IPO pair is a public-markets filing decision by the two leaders. Different capital markets.

Grok 4.7 appearing on SpaceXAI release notes (45202, +12.5 spot) is a different vendor's release cadence from Anthropic's, so it stays a singleton rather than joining anthropic_release_and_access_2026.
A human at number one on the MarketPulse leaderboard on 08-25 (45173, +34.9 spot) is a different tournament with a different field and a different date from the Summer 2026 Metaculus Cup standings.

Peak daily People's Liberation Army aircraft tracked by Taiwan (44267, -95.7 spot, the wave's worst miss), International Stabilization Force deployment into Gaza (45163) and a US strike on JNIM in Mali (45186) are three unrelated theatres. Grouping them as geopolitics would be a category cluster, which the rule forbids.
